findings.highlight: destroys the wall of the castle
findings.evidenceJa: 城の壁を貫き、広間の壁を倒壊させていく
findings.governingReading: pierces the castle wall and brings down the wall of the great hall
findings.explanation: Two distinct structures and the projectile’s path collapse into one wall.

findings.evidenceJa: 家ほどもある瓦礫の塊
findings.governingReading: a mass of rubble as large as a house
findings.explanation: The lethal scale of the falling ruin is heavily weakened.

findings.governingReading: my blood boils
findings.explanation: The classic branch replaces the bodily rage image with an unsupported mental diagnosis.

findings.evidenceJa: 脳を不能なまでにかき回している
findings.governingReading: churns my brain until it can no longer function
findings.explanation: The impending cognitive breakdown caused by contradictory impulses disappears.

findings.governingReading: you are not even worth discussing
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s dismissive evaluation becomes an unclear demonstrative.

findings.highlight: should come down to kill Emiya Shirou
findings.governingReading: will come down and finish Emiya Shirou
findings.explanation: A certain imminent killing blow becomes modal expectation.

findings.highlight: the other side of the wall
findings.governingReading: against the wall diametrically opposite me
findings.explanation: Shinji is relocated through or beyond a wall rather than across the hall.

findings.highlight: I was like that when Rider got killed
findings.evidenceJa: 僕もライダーの時はそうだった
findings.governingReading: I was the same way in Rider’s case
findings.explanation: Shinji’s vague comparison to his experience with Rider is promoted into her death.

findings.evidenceJa: あいつの剣を投影する
findings.governingReading: projecting that man’s sword
findings.explanation: The immediate projected object becomes an unspecified plural arsenal.

findings.governingReading: who holds the highest position here
findings.explanation: Shinji’s status obsession is rewritten as combat power.

findings.evidenceJa: このままじゃ確実に死ぬ
findings.governingReading: you will certainly die if this continues
findings.explanation: The conditional situation and certainty are weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: よくわからない事を、口にした
findings.governingReading: he says something I cannot make sense of
findings.explanation: Shirou’s failure to understand Shinji’s offer becomes a claim that it is inconceivable.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣をようやく一閃させ
findings.governingReading: finally sends his sword flashing down
findings.explanation: A typo leaves the imminent strike grammatically incomplete.

findings.governingReading: W-what
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses Shinji’s stammer.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂をなめ回すような視線
findings.governingReading: his gaze crawls over Tohsaka as though licking her
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s objectifying scrutiny of Rin is entirely neutralized.

findings.highlight: because you know I would not stop
findings.governingReading: because you judged that I would not stop, girl
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s condescending form of address disappears.

findings.governingReading: No—the situation has changed
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses “No” and “the.”

findings.governingReading: Shinji’s breath catches
findings.explanation: A momentary shock reaction can read as literal death.

findings.governingReading: I see—no, I’m delighted
findings.explanation: Collapsed spacing produces “seewow” and blurs Shinji’s abrupt emotional turn.

findings.highlight: make one that will even beat Caster
findings.evidenceJa: 負けないモノが作れる
findings.governingReading: create something that will not lose even to Caster’s group
findings.explanation: A defensive parity claim becomes a direct promise of victory.

findings.highlight: I’m warning you since I’ve known you for a long time
findings.governingReading: I warn you because of our long, ill-fated attachment
findings.explanation: Rin’s barbed acknowledgment of her history with Shinji is neutralized.

findings.highlight: get some intelligence to observe what’s going on
findings.evidenceJa: 周りを観察する知力を養いなさい
findings.governingReading: cultivate enough intelligence to observe your surroundings
findings.explanation: Rin’s precise cutting instruction becomes unidiomatic English.

findings.governingReading: red mass
findings.explanation: The mature branch explicitly identifies flesh where the Japanese maintains visual indirection.

findings.governingReading: that thing, still throbbing
findings.explanation: The mature branch again supplies the organ noun deliberately withheld by the Japanese.

findings.highlight: he ripped out of that girl
findings.evidenceJa: 白い少女から取り出した
findings.governingReading: he had taken from the white girl
findings.explanation: The extraction is intensified into a tearing action and the girl’s defining color disappears.

findings.governingReading: you’ll regret this, Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Shinji’s threat is reversed into an instruction not to feel regret.

findings.governingReading: the sight of his Master raging
findings.explanation: The narration’s neutral description of Shinji’s anger becomes an added moral judgment.
